background_story: Vincenzo was a man who embodied the concept of boringness. He lived a life of monotony, where every day blended into the next. His job as an accountant was a perfect fit, as he spent most of his days staring at spreadsheets and crunching numbers. His social life was equally uneventful, consisting of weekly visits to his parents' house for dinner and the occasional trip to the grocery store. Vincenzo's idea of excitement was reorganizing his sock drawer or watching paint dry. Despite his dull existence, he found comfort in the predictability of it all. His friends and family had grown accustomed to his boringness, often joking that he could put a glass of warm milk to sleep. Vincenzo didn't mind; he was content with his humdrum life, and that was all that mattered.
